critical_steps: Two conditional expectations restrict the commutator to three mass-positive rectangular blocks.

correctness.rationale: Explicit coordinate conditioning yields the three-block matrices P0 and Q0 for all probability spaces. Their skew commutator kernel gives exact row absolute sums and sign witnesses; L1 follows by duality. The skew-symmetric normalized three-block matrix has squared spectral radius pq(1-pq), rank exactly two. Positive p,q and their complements justify all divisions. All 14,358 exact-rational regression assertions passed, without treating finite checks as infinite proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General two-orthogonal-projection spectral-angle theory covers the L2 component and the 1/2 bound; it cannot determine the L-infinity norm because Hilbert-unitary equivalence does not preserve L-infinity geometry. Even exact individual norms of PQ and QP do not determine the norm of PQ-QP.

Residual risk of a hidden earlier endpoint computation remains.

value.rationale: Deleting a Cartesian product rectangle is a natural first structural-zero departure from independent product sampling and models row/column aggregation with forbidden observations. The theorem gives a full two-mass, sharp, attained endpoint norm and maximizing-block phase diagram on arbitrary probability spaces, together with an asymptotically maximal two-unit endpoint discrepancy when the Hilbert commutator norm vanishes. The structural rank reduction and cross-norm separation motivate the exact invariant beyond a single arbitrary table calculation.
